Benefit receipt in the longer historical record
Archival statistics with definition breaks | Points are observed; missing years are not imputed. Before 1990 stocks refer to
March, then June. Definitions, age coverage and eligibility changed; these are not modern working-age backcasts or unemployment
Sources: MSD Statistical Report 2012, Table OT.3: selected recipient observations 1940-2012
